name: Secret of Magical Discipline (Mythic)
body:
Your magical versatility is unparalleled.

Prerequisite(s): Secret of Magical Discipline.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use Secret of Magical Discipline.

This stacks with additional uses of the ability per day gained through the non-mythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Secret of Magical Discipline, this feat may be selected only once.
